title: Remote phone panel
responsibility: Guides pairing from a phone and displays connection status and granted access.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.store
inputs.description: The RemotePhone store (a RemotePhoneState instance) that the panel reads status, busy, error, scanFailure and fixture from and calls scan(name) and disconnect() on; nothing renders while status is null. Scan receives the name typed in the form, initially iPhone, which the store trims and, when the result is empty or longer than 80 characters, refuses with its notice without starting a scan.

inputs.name: RemotePhonePanel.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag that is false by default. When it is true, the unpaired heading, instructions, reason and setup form, the grant and phone identity lines and the fixture notice are not rendered, while the status title, any detail and the action button still render outside the unpaired state and any store error still renders.

outputs.name: RemotePhonePanel
outputs.description: The Computer connection section renders when status and labels are set. The full unpaired view guides the phone through scanning a pairing code. When online, the full view opens a Connection dialog with connection details, the grant, the phone identity, Disconnect and Sign out. A phone with the Vault grant and a native inbox port can open Vault requests from this dialog. The compact view shows status and a connection action. Store errors, scan failures and a refused Vault launch are reported in their respective views.
